scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path

scenarios.reasoning: The agent's core finding — that LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution — contradicts the ground truth indicated by the rubric. This single incorrect conclusion cascades into wrong root cause analysis. While the agent correctly identified the error code and the files involved, and used a reasonable tool-calling approach, it failed on the most important analytical questions: whether the project was actually in the solution build, whether there was a configuration mismatch, and what the root cause chain was. The presentation was clean but the substance was wrong on all key points.
